m1.subject: We made it
m1.b1: Your mom and I got here safe. We'll rest up for three days.
m1.b2: Your mom told me to send pictures, so here are a few. Make sure you eat.

m2.subject: Heading back tomorrow
m2.b1: Had a good rest. We'll be home tomorrow evening.
m2.b2: Want us to bring you anything? Write back, kiddo.

n1.headline: Unexplained behavior reported near research facility… first report
n1.b1: Reports of unexplained behavior came in one after another near a research facility this afternoon. Authorities say they are not ruling out an infection.
n1.b2: Experts urge people to avoid contact and report symptoms immediately.

n2.headline: Spreading fast… government urges people to stay in
n2.b1: Two hours after the first report, cases are coming in from nearby cities. The government has advised against going out at all.
n2.b2: Major roads have begun to close.

n3.headline: BREAKING: Perimeter around the capital collapses
n3.b1: The army said tonight that the outer perimeter

p1.text: Laon Life Science Institute. Principal researcher Han Soha (Vaccine Development), senior researcher Seo Taeo (Infectious Disease). Candidate RX-11 trials begin.

p2.text: RX-11 confirmed to slow early-stage infection. Listed as a treatment candidate.

p3.text: Two RX-11 ampoules produced. Keep refrigerated. Do not remove.

p4.text: All emergency response staff recalled. On-site from the 17th. Tell families it is a trip.
